name: Cricket
description: Cricket from village greens in England to the World Cup, the Ashes and the IPL: the matches, teams and players that made the game loved across South Asia, Australia, England and the Caribbean.

checkpoints.name: The English game
checkpoints.note: Cricket grows on English village greens and estates. The Marylebone Cricket Club writes its laws, and the British carry the game to India, Australia, South Africa and the Caribbean.

checkpoints.name: Test cricket
checkpoints.note: England and Australia play the first Test in 1877 and the Ashes from 1882. Bradman's Australia, then the West Indies, India and Pakistan join the five-day game.

checkpoints.name: World Cups
checkpoints.note: The one-day World Cup starts in 1975. The West Indies rule the game, India's win in 1983 makes cricket India's passion, and Tendulkar, Lara, Warne and Muralitharan break records.

checkpoints.name: The T20 age
checkpoints.note: The twenty-over game and the IPL bring money, floodlights and global stars. India becomes the centre of world cricket.
